insights.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue was about ₹1,310 Cr with EBITDA of ₹303 Cr (23.1% margin), up 49% year on year, though margins were hit by input costs, labour and mix. The net order book stood at ₹240 Bn (₹24,000 Cr). Management unveiled 'Sona Comstar 2.0' (another 10x company in a decade) and a Denso joint-venture structure: JV1 for 2- and 3-wheeler motors and JV2 for high-voltage technology, with no timing disclosed.
